answer: The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. Take the prism away and the name goes; take the tide away and the stake goes; take the atlas away and the past goes. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Notary scribe charter page warrant lettered across the chancery office is that proof, written as each charter page is a sheet record witnessed by the inspector. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 10 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 162 proofs any faster.
